name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley. Kneel below it on the knee of the working side, with the other foot flat in front of you. Use a pad under your knee.
Hold the handle with your arm straight above you and let the cable pull your shoulder up into a stretch.
Brace your trunk and keep your hips square.
Pull your elbow down and in toward your hip until the handle is near your shoulder.
Pause for a moment, then let your arm go back up under control to a full stretch.
Do all the repetitions on one side, then change sides.
